purpose: Define a shared sieve for consciousness proxies, source promotion, external constraints, and null-result overclaims.

sieve_rules.name: source_authority_not_support
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: Row must list exactly which claim IDs the source supports, does not support, or only contextualizes.

sieve_rules.name: standard_not_validation
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: Separate schema conformance from physical derivation and empirical result rows.

sieve_rules.name: null_not_absence
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: State tested regime, detection limit, residual definition, and non-tested regimes.

sieve_rules.name: constraint_not_safety
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: Map candidate parameter to observable and bound with assumptions before any compatibility language is allowed.

sieve_rules.name: proxy_not_consciousness
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: List proxy target, alternative explanations, discriminant tests, and public claim boundary.

sieve_rules.name: agent_identifier_not_personhood
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: Agent identifiers remain process attribution only.

sieve_rules.name: journey_context_not_canon
sieve_rules.required_discriminant: Require local path/line references and journey_context_not_canon classification for any future use.
